title: Add task placeholder helper tests
instructions: Add focused tests for src/core/task-placeholders.ts. Cover that unresolvedTaskPlaceholders reports placeholders from targetFiles, forbiddenChanges, setupCommands, verifyCommands, instructions, and expectedCommitSubject with sorted unique names. Cover that unresolvedDispatchPlaceholders excludes instruction-only CLI metavars such as --run-log=<path> while still reporting placeholders from dispatch-critical fields. Do not change behavior unless the tests expose a real bug. Do not add CLI surface, docs, templates, playbooks, policy, profiles, remote adapters, daemon/watch behavior, dashboards, routine triggers, hidden memory, or promoted learning artifact edits.
